cases.description: single extracted row -> one result, extracted_content is a JSON string of a one-element array, tagged with its bucket_file_id (recovered via pairedItem, since $json itself no longer carries it by this point)
multiple rows from the SAME file (e.g. a multi-row CSV) -> one result, extracted_content is a JSON string of all rows, in order

REGRESSION: rows from TWO DIFFERENT files interleaved in one combined run (Merge Extraction Branches upstream joins every mime-type branch into one stream) -> grouped back into one result PER FILE, not one blob mixing both files together
